original.prompt: Consider the following statements about the India–US trade deal terms announced in February 2026:
items: The US will cut tariffs on Indian goods from 50% to 18%.
India will cut tariffs on US industrial goods from roughly 13.5% to 5%.
India committed to buying USD 500 billion in American goods over five years.
original.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
original.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because India will drop tariffs on US industrial goods from roughly 13.5% to zero, not 5%. India plans to meet the USD 500 billion commitment by gradually ramping up purchases of petroleum, aircraft, defence, telecom and pharmaceutical goods.
original.source: India will drop tariffs on US industrial goods from roughly 13.5% to zero.
